source: Chalk Circle v1.1 Layer Router / TRIUNE architecture

layers.name: THE GATE

layers.name: ANTECHAMBER

layers.function: Surface repeated or contradictory behavior as deterministic state.

layers.function: Represent accumulated constraint, cost, scrutiny and tradeoff pressure.

layers.name: THE REFUSAL
layers.function: Terminal no-go state for explicit refusal or runaway recursion.
